digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / G7 criteria routing and rubric
propositions: G7 routing entry must change from default_posture advisory at 0.95 to default_posture blocking at 0.85 to eliminate false negatives while maintaining zero clearly-incorrect findings at priority >= 0.85 across 348 historical findings.

Plan-review blocking gates on default_posture and block_threshold alone; kind scoping flows through existing plan-v4 divergence grading where contradicts_reality and omits_required_site hard-floor impact at 0.85, while incomplete_enumeration contributes 0.55 and cannot reach 0.85 via divergence axis.

Rubric must add four new rules: abstain-with-coverage on unresolvable parent (never emit a finding), closed-parent final-state check with sibling-handoff carve-out, one-finding-per-contradicted-parent-clause dedup, and floor-kind guidance to prevent wording mismatches from inflating incomplete_enumeration.
All three pinned blocking-set assertions and the G7 posture test must reflect the new (0.85, blocking) configuration; docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md must be regenerated.
No changes to pass3_decide, threshold_for, or decide.py dedup machinery; per-grade Pass-3 gating rejected in favor of rubric guidance, matching the bfa8 T3/T10 and c97a T5c precedent patterns.
